Container.Name: subgen
Container.DonateText: If you appreciate my work, then please consider donating
Container.Overview: subgen will transcribe your personal media on a Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin server to create subtitles (.srt) from audio/video files, it can also be used as a Whisper Provider in Bazarr. Uses whisper.cpp. Repository tag by hardware: mccloud/subgen (NVIDIA, keep --gpus all in Extra Parameters), mccloud/subgen:vulkan (Intel/AMD GPU: replace --gpus all with --device /dev/dri), mccloud/subgen:cpu (no GPU: remove --gpus all).
Container.Changes: Now uses whisper.cpp. Models are kept in /subgen/models. Removed TRANSCRIBE_DEVICE, COMPUTE_TYPE, WORD_LEVEL_HIGHLIGHT and CUSTOM_REGROUP (no longer used).

Config.Name: Port: Webhook Port
Config.Description: This is the port for the webhook

Config.Name: Path: Models
Config.Description: Where whisper.cpp models are downloaded and kept (one file per model, about 0.5 to 3 GB).

Config.Name: Variable: WHISPER_MODEL
Config.Description: Whisper model. large-v3-turbo-q5_0 (about 1 GB) is fast and accurate on any GPU. Others: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3, large-v3-turbo, distil-large-v3.5, and -q5_0 / -q8_0 quantized versions. large-v3-turbo can't translate; use large-v3 for TRANSCRIBE_OR_TRANSLATE=translate. See the README's Choosing a model.

Config.Name: Variable: CONCURRENT_TRANSCRIPTIONS
Config.Description: Number of files it will transcribe in parallel. Each one loads its own copy of the model, so memory grows with this number.

Config.Name: Variable: WHISPER_THREADS
Config.Description: CPU threads per transcription. Leave empty to share the CPU cores between CONCURRENT_TRANSCRIPTIONS automatically.

Config.Name: Variable: MODEL_PATH
Config.Description: Where models are stored inside the container. Keep it at /subgen/models to match the Models path.

Config.Name: Variable: PROCADDEDMEDIA
Config.Description: will gen subtitles for all media added regardless of existing external/embedded subtitles (based off of SKIPIFINTERNALSUBLANG)

Config.Name: Variable: PROCMEDIAONPLAY
Config.Description: will gen subtitles for all played media regardless of existing external/embedded subtitles (based off of SKIPIFINTERNALSUBLANG)

Config.Name: Variable: NAMESUBLANG
Config.Description: allows you to pick what it will name the subtitle. Instead of using EN, I'm using AA, so it doesn't mix with exiting external EN subs, and AA will populate higher on the list in Plex.

Config.Name: Variable: SKIPIFINTERNALSUBLANG
Config.Description: Will not generate a subtitle if the file has an internal sub matching the 3 letter code of this variable (See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes)

Config.Name: Variable: PLEXSERVER
Config.Description: This needs to be set to your local plex server address/port

Config.Name: Variable: PLEXTOKEN
Config.Description: This needs to be set to your plex token found by https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/

Config.Name: Variable: JELLYFINSERVER
Config.Description: Set to your Jellyfin server address/port

Config.Name: Variable: JELLYFINTOKEN
Config.Description: Generate a token inside the Jellyfin interface

Config.Name: Variable: WEBHOOKPORT
Config.Description: Change this if you need a different port for your webhook

Config.Name: Variable: TRANSCRIBE_FOLDERS
Config.Description: Takes a pipe '|' separated list (For example: /tv|/movies|/familyvideos) and iterates through and adds those files to be queued for subtitle generation if they don't have internal subtitles

Config.Name: Variable: TRANSCRIBE_OR_TRANSLATE
Config.Description: Takes either 'transcribe' or 'translate'. Transcribe will transcribe the audio in the same language as the input. Translate will transcribe and translate into English.

Config.Name: Variable: DEBUG
Config.Description: Provides some debug data that can be helpful to troubleshoot path mapping and other issues.

Config.Name: Variable: FORCE_DETECTED_LANGUAGE_TO
Config.Description: This is to force the model to a language instead of the detected one, takes a 2 letter language code. For example, your audio is French but keeps detecting as English, you would set it to 'fr'

Config.Name: Variable: CLEAR_VRAM_ON_COMPLETE
Config.Description: This will delete the model and do garbage collection when queue is empty. Good if you need to use the VRAM for something else.

Config.Name: Variable: UPDATE
Config.Description: Will pull latest subgen.py from the repository if True. False will use the original subgen.py built into the Docker image. Standalone users can use this with launcher.py to get updates.

Config.Name: Variable: APPEND
Config.Description: Will add the following at the end of a subtitle: 'Transcribed by whisperAI with whisper.cpp (model) on (date)'

Config.Name: Variable: MONITOR
Config.Description: Will monitor TRANSCRIBE_FOLDERS for real-time changes to see if we need to generate subtitles

Config.Name: Variable: USE_MODEL_PROMPT
Config.Description: When set to True, will use the default prompt stored in greetings_translations 'Hello, welcome to my lecture.' to try and force the use of punctuation in transcriptions that don't.

Config.Name: Variable: CUSTOM_MODEL_PROMPT
Config.Description: If USE_MODEL_PROMPT is True, you can override the default prompt (See: https://medium.com/axinc-ai/prompt-engineering-in-whisper-6bb18003562d for great examples).

Config.Name: Variable: LRC_FOR_AUDIO_FILES
Config.Description: Will generate LRC (instead of SRT) files for filetypes: '.mp3', '.flac', '.wav', '.alac', '.ape', '.ogg', '.wma', '.m4a', '.m4b', '.aac', '.aiff'
